notes.title: Update 0.72 - The Even More Optimizations Update-
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32574578/fd4e9e6bc6feeee9fe63b9011e2461ea7fc6a02a.png[/img]

Howdy fellow farmers!

Introducing Update 0.72. This update is exclusively about quality of life improvements. 

The first thing you will notice is a new and revamped Rotation Solution for the camera, it is much more responsive and is no longer vulnerable to becoming unresponsive when the player owns more than 100 chickens.

This was a pesky bug that took me awhile to hunt down and couldn't have done it without the help of community members who contributed on the forums and helped diagnose  this issue.

It should take no time for  you to get accustomed to the new custom  solution,  it is definitely an improvement over the old camera.

The Chicken Hive Mind machine learning system  will reduce the frequency it has the chickens scan their environment for obstructions by 50% when player possesses more than 80 chickens in order to reduce processor overhead in late game. This comes with a reduction in response time for chickens but it shouldn't impact  the chicken's navigational skills as by then they should be decent enough in traversing the corral.

Other Minor Tweaks included as well, for example, the camera will no longer clip below ground when zoomed all the way in. Check out the improvements and don't forget to participate on the forums.

Cheers!

notes.title: Major Performance Optimization - Update 0.71-
notes.content:
Today, thanks to feedback from the community, I was able to pinpoint several performance degrading issues.  After identifying this issues and confirming through heavy CPU and GPU profiling. I then Implemented the following changes:

-Removed one of the Landscape's sub shaders that used indiscriminately a World Position Offset solution to create a faux depth for the grass texture at distance. 

-Changed the deprecated Landscape sub shaders for a more conservative but creative artistic solution (a solution similar to the one used for the dynamic grass).

-Improved the Chicken's LODs in over 60% achieving a reduction in chicken polycount now of over 85%

-Changed the method for GI and AO to a more conservative solution based on a  performance/aspect compromise (in contrast from just aspect).

[b]I am super thrilled to report that test benches workstations have an improvement in performance in up to 20fps. [/b]

Please try the patch yourselves and let me know on the forums how much of an improvement it makes!

Cheers!

-Changed the deprecated Landscape sub shaders for a more conservative but creative artistic solution (a solution similar to the one used for the dynamic grass).
-Improved the Chicken's LODs in over 60% achieving a reduction in chicken polycount now of over 85%
-Changed the method for GI and AO to a more conservative solution based on a  performance/aspect compromise (in contrast from just aspect).

Today  we have achieved a major milestone in Corral’s development. All base features are now available for you! I find it best to release Update 0.7 in smaller compartmentalized patches (so if a major bug or error occurs I can pinpoint and solve it faster).

Pageant Circuits will be released in the following calendar:

[edit]
-Ill be releasing the remaining circuits throughout this month, I had specific release dates, but I'll be releasing performance optimization updates also between circuit releases. [/edit]

If everything goes as planned some circuits could be released a lot earlier.
Please don’t hesitate to provide feedback or report any bugs you experience, both your opinion and contribution are of the utmost important for Corral.

P.D I’ll be posting soon another thread on the forum with a in depth explanation of Pageant Circuits. Stay Tuned!

notes.title: IMPORTANT Emergency Patch - 0.622-!
notes.content:
Effective immediately I'm releasing an emergency patch that solves the Food Processor UI failure which consists in farmers not being able of loading new food into the Food Processor.

The issue was isolated with help of one of our community members and determined to be a discrepancy between the Food Processors internal library and the updated Food Library which handles all the fruits, veggies and cereals.

The Food Library was updated two patches ago to introduce new vegetables and fruits, and due to the sensitive nature of this Library (which is used to identify food correctly in a  ' procedimental' manner) it has to be updated also in all the applications that carry it (imagine  a new word was invented but it wasn't included on the dictionary;thus you are unable to understand what it means).

It has been solved now, but  in case any trouble persists, please don't hesitate to reach out to me on the forums or either in corral's or my social media accounts: Twitter or Instagram.

Twitter: @TheSHERRlNFORD 
Instagram: corralthegame
Instagram: thesherrinford

[b]Please make sure your client is updated to version 0.622! [/b]

Squawk!

notes.title: Update 0.6 (The Nutrition Update) is now Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32574578/a4e24f99bb9a9f68e10ed8d4177aead27e24f0c0.png[/img]


[b]Howdy fellow farmers! Enter Update 0.6.[/b]

The Nutrition Update , as i’ve been teasing these past days, introduces a food system that allows you to grow Vegetables, Fruits and Grains  and mix them up to make food for your chickens. 
The two most noticeable changes will be that both the Barn Tab in the  Corral Tabs section of the screen and the Nutrition Tab inside the Farmer’s Digest are now accessible to you. 

-The Barn Tab is basically your inventory, where you will stash all Fruits, Veggies and Grains that grow in your corral.

-The Nutrition Tab will allow you to buy all you need to manufacture food: plants, seeded pots, paddies, vines, extra nutrients and vitamins. You name it.

-Food Processors are available in the Farmer’s Digest Construction Tab, these will allow you to mix all your crops into nutritious pellets.

[b]Right now I’m introducing 2 kinds of crops: Pitaya and Rice, 1 type of food processor: DIY Processor and added the Manual Water Extractor to the Farmer’s Welcome package. [/b]

[b]Tomorrow in a follow up patch I’ll be introducing 3 kinds of crops: Tomato, Wheat and Carrot; 3 types of Extra Nutrients: Protein, Vitamin and Zinc, as well as a Small Water Pump which will extract water automatically only using energy. This is order to receive player feedback and make any pertinent changes before delivering the bulk of content. I want to know what you guys and gals think.[/b]

[b]Patch Notes:
Update 0.6[/b]
-Nutrition System Implemented.
-Rice Paddy and Manual Water Extractor added to the Welcome Package.
-2 New Crops: Pitaya and Rice.
-DIY Food Processor Implemented.
-Barn Inventory Tab Enabled.
-Farmer’s Digest Nutrition Tab Enabled.
-UI Improvements.
-Minor Bug Fixes.

Squawk away!

notes.title: Update 0.6 Launch Postponed to June the 3rd at 15:00h(CDT)
notes.content:
As most of you guys and gals know Update 0.6 is upon us, this update has an important addition to the game content.

 I'm talking about the Nutrition System, this gameplay addition will allow you to grow Fruits, Veggies and Grains and mix them up to make food for your chickens. It is a quite promising enhancement to the game.

In order to implement it several major systems had to be modified and a lot of content (both under and over the hood) has been added to the game. Therefore  there is a lot to test and review on the Quality Control part of the development.

[b]Today I took the decision to postpone the Update release date by 24 hours. This, in order to allow for further testing and clearance of critical systems. I think this will let me deliver the best possible content to you my fellow farmers.[/b]

Time Conversions

[b]CDT - 15:00
BST - 4:00
PDT - 20:00[/b]

Delaying the update even for 10 minutes was the last thing I wanted to do, but I discussed it with both the Asset Development Director (which is me) and the Creative Director (also me) and we decided it was the better choice.

See you tomorrow!
